lockFileMaintenance.description: Refreshes yarn.lock so transitive deps pick up patched versions. vulnerabilityAlerts below only covers direct deps in package.json, so this is what remediates transitive CVEs. NOTE: schedule is temporarily 'at any time' to force an initial catch-up run; restore to 'before 8am on monday' once that lands.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security PRs bypass schedule and prConcurrentLimit by default, but not prHourlyLimit - so unset it here.
